publicationRule: New v4 has passed species-recognition review on black/white, byte integrity and credited photo fallback; activation requires release/browser checks.

items.name: Rødkløver
items.observations: New generated red clover plant has accurate trifoliate foliage with pale V-marks, hairy stems and visible taproot. However, the flower heads are too strongly composed of repeated pointed, closed florets and fail to reliably show the opened papilionaceous standard, wings and keel.
requiredRedraw: Illustrate densely clustered rounded or broadly ovoid heads with a convincing mix of opened papilionaceous flowers
Ensure banners/standards and paired wings are distinguishable in some facing flowers, not just pointed tips
Retain three oval leaflets per compound leaf, pale markings, paired leaflets below flowerhead, and root structure
Recheck against botanical sources at full size and 390/1440 display sizes
items.note: Original generated illustration preserved as a candidate only; never activate or silently raise approved count from 15.

items.name: Rødkløver
items.observations: Compared to previous rejected v3, this original v4 has more rounded pink flower heads with visible contrasting partly unfolded florets, recognizable trifoliate oval leaves with pale V-shaped markings, pubescent upright stems, and a taproot. Botanical traits align at artskort scale.
items.limitations: The illustration is not diagnostic at microscopic floral level; details of the banner, wing and keel in individual florets should not be used for definitive species identification. Published display retains a sourced photographic fallback.
items.reviewNotes: v4 independently reviewed on black and white backgrounds at full resolution. v3 is still rejected, preserved, and never activated.

releaseScope: Only the new v4 image is active. Older b05 and b08/v3 versions remain rejected in review histories.
